subject: DataTable search box in Shiny does not like special characters

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: DataTable search box in Shiny does not like special characters
parts:
I have a DataTable from DT version  0.1 in a shiny app - shiny version 0.12.1.

In general it is working fine, but I have an issue with the search box. One of the columns has a list of names, and some of the names contain an &. 
When I try to use the main search box it does not recognize the & and does only searches on characters that come before it - so for A&B it will only search for A

If I check the contents of input$myTable_search, the ampersand is displayed correctly.

If I make the same datatable outside of shiny it works fine.

Any ideas on what is going on?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: DataTable search box in Shiny does not like special characters
parts:
Thanks for the report! I believe it is a bug of DataTables, which does
not encode & as %26 when sending the Ajax request. Anyway, I just
fixed it in the latest development version of DT:
https://github.com/rstudio/DT

Regards,
Yihui
